findings.evidence: Precedent: Completion.lean:426 `completion_ringOfDefinition` and :435 `mem_completion_idealOfDefinition`; LaurentSeries.lean:177 `pairOfDefinition_ringOfDefinition` and :186 `mem_pairOfDefinition_idealOfDefinition_pow_iff`. Bodies are opaque in this repo (`@[expose]` used across 227 files; this file states at line 36 and 119 that its def bodies are not exported).
findings.fix: Add `@[simp] theorem locPairOfDefinition_ringOfDefinition ... : (locPairOfDefinition P T s S hden).ringOfDefinition = locSubring P T s S := (rfl)` and, because `idealOfDefinition`'s type depends on `ringOfDefinition`, a membership form `@[simp] theorem mem_locPairOfDefinition_idealOfDefinition ...` mirroring `mem_completion_idealOfDefinition`, and list them in the module docstring.
findings.issue: `locPairOfDefinition` is public with an unexposed body and no projection lemmas, so a consumer (e.g. Layer 3.1 attaching an `A⁺` to the rational localisation) cannot prove `(locPairOfDefinition P T s S hden).ringOfDefinition = locSubring P T s S`, nor characterise its `idealOfDefinition`. Both existing `PairOfDefinition`-valued defs in the repo supply exactly these.

summary: The assembly is the right surface and `isHuberRing_locTopology` is fine, but `locPairOfDefinition` ships with no characteristic lemmas: its body is not exposed, so downstream code cannot recover that its ring of definition is `D` or its ideal is `J`.
